method: Manually targeted, not a bulk scrape - looked up individually, one product page at a time via normal browsing, only for the specific cards confirmed to have no loose (TCGplayer/Cardmarket) or PSA price anywhere else in this mirror. Not on an automated refresh schedule, unlike data/sets/ and data/psa/ - re-run manually if this snapshot goes stale.
note: Two entries (McDonald's 2018 Pikachu #4 and Chansey #10) show large jumps between grade9 and psa10 that look like thin-sample anomalies rather than real market consensus - spot-check on the live site before relying on those two specifically.
